description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the JobRegisterService, specifically the JobRegisterServiceImpl class, which manages scheduling, executing, rescheduling, pausing, and stopping jobs using Quartz Scheduler within the Apache Fineract platform. It also handles job creation, event listening for application context closure, and interacts with various other services related to job and scheduler management.

classes.name: JobRegisterServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the JobRegisterService managing Quartz schedules for Fineract jobs, handling job scheduling, execution, rescheduling, pausing, and shutdown procedures, integrated with Spring and Quartz frameworks.

methods.name: executeJob
methods.description: Executes a scheduled job by creating or retrieving its scheduler and triggering it with appropriate parameters.

methods.name: rescheduleJob
methods.description: Reschedules an existing job by deleting the current schedule and creating a new one.

methods.name: pauseScheduler
methods.description: Pauses the scheduler by updating the scheduler detail status.

methods.name: startScheduler
methods.description: Starts the scheduler, potentially executing any misfired trigger jobs.

methods.name: executeJobWithParameters
methods.description: Allows external components to trigger execution of a job with specific JSON-encoded parameters.

methods.name: isSchedulerRunning
methods.description: Checks if the scheduler is active and not suspended.

methods.name: onApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles the application context closure event to shutdown all schedulers gracefully.

methods.name: scheduleJob
methods.description: Schedules a new job with a trigger based on the provided ScheduledJobDetail.

methods.name: stopScheduler
methods.description: Stops a specific scheduler by name.
